# Computatio

> Computatio (Computatio Inc.) provides AI-assisted monthly bookkeeping for owner-led agencies and service businesses with 2 to 15 people, and fixed-price tax returns for self-employed owners. AI does the sorting and matching; a person reviews and signs off on every account. Based in San Diego, California, serving clients across the United States.

## Services

- [Monthly Books](https://computatio.io/monthly-bookkeeping/): $500 a month, month to month. Books categorized, reconciled and closed every month; a one-page plain-English summary by the 15th; a 30-minute monthly review call. Covers up to 2 bank accounts and 2 credit cards.
- [Books cleanup](https://computatio.io/books-cleanup/): $500 to $1,500 one time, quoted before work starts, for books that are behind.
- [Tax returns](https://computatio.io/tax-returns/): Simple Return $350, Self-Employed Return $600, Owner-Operator Return $900.
